description: Switching from the pistol to the shotgun lowers the pistol (lower_time 0.2 s), then raises the shotgun (raise_time 0.25 s), with no firing until it is up. Then holding attack fires the shotgun every fire_interval (0.9 s).

expect.note: Tick 12: still lowering the pistol, which started on tick 1 and takes 12 ticks. Attack is held, but nothing fires.
Tick 27: raising takes 15 ticks, so the shotgun isn't up until tick 28.
The first shotgun shot is on tick 28, lower_time + raise_time (27 ticks) after the key was pressed.
Shotgun shots on ticks 28, 82, and 136 (54 ticks apart); the fourth would be on tick 190, after 3 s.
